entries.ff8652e0d916b497: The company manufactures and sells optical transmission systems, security and surveillance systems, remote measurement and sensing systems, and related equipment for wireless application systems. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥20,730 million, making it the core of the group's revenue.
